messages:
Incident-Bot: [ALERT] High error + latency spike detected on embeddings service (embed.svc). 2.3x normal qps, elevated 429s and backing-off clients. Auto-mitigation not triggered (rate-tier mismatch). Paging oncall.

Rohit (oncall): got it, i'm on. can someone pull the top IPs / userids hitting embed.svc? look like a scrape.

Eli (infra): pulling logs now. preliminary: ~4000 distinct client tokens in last 5m, but 3 client tokens account for ~55% of tokens. user_agent strings are botlike: "curl/7.82" + empty referer. Sequence lengths ~16 tokens (embedding calls).

Maya (security): probable scraper farm or credentialed proxy. let's not immediately ban; we should apply conservative WAF rules and tighten per-token quotas. recommend GEO throttle for APAC nodes (spike concentrated there).

Nicole (support): heads-up: we have two customers on Dedicated capacity who may see increased latency on embedding endpoints. I'm preparing a quick blurb for high-touch customers.

Rohit (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable /v1/embeddings batch endpoint to reduce variance from large fanout 2) apply WAF rule to block frequent short-window token churn 3) tighten per-key QPS to 20r/s for new requests. Eli, can you flip the batch flag?

Eli (infra): yes. flipping feature flag for embed-batch to OFF now. command:
```bash
# toggle feature flag in prod-control API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"embed-batch","value":false}' \
  https://prod-control.internal/flags/toggle
```
Applying... Ops-Bot will report deployment.

Ops-Bot: feature-flag:update succeeded (embed-batch=false) at 2160456802. Rolling change pushed to all regions. :white_check_mark:

Rohit (oncall): nice. watch metrics for tail latency. Maya, WAF rules?

Maya (security): adding rule to rate-limit by IP and UA fingerprint, drop if > 100 reqs/min with small seq len. snippet we pushed to waf-console: 
```json
{
  "match": {"path": "/v1/embeddings", "method":"POST"},
  "conditions": [
    {"field":"user_agent","op":"contains","value":"curl"},
    {"field":"requests_per_minute","op":">","value":100}
  ],
  "action":"challenge_or_block",
  "scope":"geo:APAC"
}
```
Pushed rule in staging, promoting to prod now.

Incident-Bot: WAF rule promotion success at 2160456815. Estimated 44% of offending traffic should be mitigated.

SRE-Oncall: confirming we also need to raise soft-quota enforcement for embeddings to prevent queue saturation. Eli, can you add a per-api-key hard cap at 60k tokens/day for now?

Eli (infra): added soft token cap via quota service: key-level cap=60k/day for new burst keys; enforcement active at 2160456824.

Rohit (oncall): traffic reduced ~38% in last 40s, 429s decreasing but some customers might see slower responses. Nicole, notify impacted customers with ETA and mitigation steps? 

Nicole (support): sending a short note to subscribers of embedding endpoints: "We've applied temporary traffic shaping and WAF rules to mitigate abusive embedding traffic. You might see elevated latencies; we're monitoring and will rollback batch disable once stable." will also attach link to status page.

SecTeam: running heuristics for credential stuffing (rapid credential tries). so far no login-service correlation, looks like token reuse from proxies. recommend blocking via IP ASN rules if continued.

Rohit (oncall): handing off to SRE-Oncall for night shift monitoring. I'm updating the incident log and will collect final metrics for postmortem. Thanks team. :pray:

SRE-Oncall: taking over monitoring. checklist: 1) watch 1m and 5m qps 2) verify embed-batch flag stays off 3) monitor false positive customers 4) escalate to infra if errors > 5% for >3m.

Rohit (oncall): quick ask for ops: after 15m, if traffic remains > 15% above baseline, plan to re-enable batch but with per-key batch limits, otherwise keep disabled and refine WAF fingerprints.

Incident-Bot: summary saved to /incidents/2160456789 (live-mitigation: embed spike -> batch disable + WAF + per-key quotas). Next update at 2160456900 or on demand.

Nicole (support): customer blurb posted to status and 3 customers notified directly (dedicated tenants).

Eli (infra): current metrics (2160456833): overall embed.svc qps down 41%, 429 rate down from 3.8%->0.9%, median latency +15% but p95 improved slightly. will attach graphs to the incident doc.

Rohit (oncall): great work. we'll run a short blameless review in morning to nail down detection -> auto-mitigation gaps. leaving this thread open for updates. :mag:
